title: Paprika Recipe Times Cooked Leaderboard
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=paprika:recipe cook_count=*
| stats sum(cook_count) as total_value, avg(cook_count) as avg_value by recipe_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks recipe values by total and average times cooked across Paprika recipe events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `cook_count` values for each Paprika recipe event and review total and average times cooked by recipe.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total times cooked.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which recipe shows the biggest times cooked numbers in your Paprika recipe data.
